question: What does a 3-, 7- or 14-night stay actually cost, and when should it be booked?

cheapest_finding.cheapest_7n_verified: Flamingo Las Vegas — Flamingo Room 2 Queens at $83/night, $581 derived for Feb 15–22, 2027, excluding taxes and resort-fee tax.
cheapest_finding.cheapest_7n_hotel_issued: South Point — $989 for the same seven nights, issued as a single total by the hotel's own engine ('including all fees', taxes excluded). It is the lowest hotel-issued 7-night figure but not the lowest of all quotes.
cheapest_finding.cheapest_14n_verified: South Point — $2,039 for Feb 15 – Mar 1, 2027. This is the only genuine 14-night quote obtained, and it matches the '1–2 weeks' brief.
cheapest_finding.window_ranking: Among windows tested with the same hotel and room, Feb 15–22, 2027 was the cheapest. Caesars Palace run-of-house rate: $209 (Feb 15–22) < $237 (Feb 15–Mar 1) < $248 (Feb 22–Mar 1) < $310 (Mar 15–22). Paris points the same way, on its cheapest published nightly rate per window: $203 (Feb 15–22) → $232 (Feb 15–Mar 1) → $233 (Mar 15–22). Mar 15–22 is the most expensive week inside the planning window.
cheapest_finding.note: Totals marked 'derived' are the hotel's own displayed nightly rate multiplied by the number of nights. No tax rate has been assumed anywhere; taxes and resort-fee tax are excluded unless the hotel published an all-in figure (only Resorts World did).

best_time_to_book.why: No official hotel source publishes a future price history or a book-now-vs-wait forecast, and none was found. The only documented timing lever is Caesars Entertainment's 'Advanced Purchase Savings — up to 30% off for stays 30+ days in advance', whose actual effect on these specific February 2027 dates is not stated by the company.
best_time_to_book.what_would_answer_it: Re-run the same exact-date searches weekly and record the movement, or ask each property for its rate-hold and cancellation policy in writing. The Feb 15–22 week already prices below the March weeks, so waiting for a lower March rate is not supported by the data collected.

fees_note: Caesars properties: resort fee $56.63 (Flamingo, Paris) or $62.30 (Caesars Palace) including tax, plus a $50–$100/day incidental deposit. Resorts World: $55/night resort fee + tax. Wynn: $55/night resort fee + tax. South Point: $29.20/night resort fee, already inside the 'including all fees' total.
